digest.component_or_area: store write seam and event validation
propositions: Event bodies containing live credentials (Anthropic keys, GitHub PATs, service tokens, etc.) are accepted by the store write path without screening, allowing secrets to be published on auto-push to the shared tickets branch

When credentials reach GitHub, push protection rejects refs/heads/tickets and wedges all concurrent agent store writes into local-only queues until manual intervention, presenting as transient contention with only a buried warning log

The write seam is not append_event alone; inbound_translate calls finalize_event's halves directly to bypass eager push, bypassing any screen placed only at append_event and leaving Jira-sourced comment bodies unscreened

A secret screen at finalize_event must not echo the secret value into exception messages, logs, stderr, or disk, and must name which detector family fired and the field path to make the override an informed choice

The screen must be safe to leave on by default, accepting benign look-alikes (truncated placeholders, regex literals, prose enumerating patterns) that appear in legitimate ticket descriptions without false-positive blocking

A refused write is logged with an audited force override (--allow-secret-pattern=<reason>) that records who forced and why on the event, making forced writes distinguishable and reversible rather than silently redacting payloads in the append-only store
